shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排大小不同的液氮罐旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of liquid nitrogen dewars of different sizes, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：杜瓦与低温储罐。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指着罐顶的安全阀和压力表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to the relief valve and pressure gauge on top of a dewar.
shots.narration: 罐子会冒气、会嘶嘶响，这正常吗？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰推着液氮罐要和别人一起挤进电梯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pushes a liquid nitrogen dewar on a trolley into a crowded lift with other people.
shots.narration: 阿杰推着液氮罐，要和大家挤电梯。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研伸手拦住，示意罐子单独上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the lift door and signals that the dewar must ride alone.
shots.narration: 小研：人罐分开！电梯一停，会缺氧。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 楼外储罐突然喷出一大团白雾，阿杰吓一跳
shots.prompt_en: Outside the building a large cryogenic storage tank suddenly releases a loud burst of white fog, startling the young male student.
shots.narration: 楼外储罐突然嘶的一声，喷出白雾。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李在围栏外摆手示意别怕
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands outside the tank yard fence and raises a calm hand.
shots.narration: 老李：别怕，那是安全阀在排气。

shots.section_title: 杜瓦罐的种类与取液器
shots.scene: 实验室杜瓦瓶、液氮生物容器、自增压液氮罐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three types of cryogenic containers, an open lab dewar flask, a sample storage container with a neck plug, and a pressurized liquid tank with a valve set on top. No text.
shots.narration: 杜瓦罐用来储存和转运低温液体。
overlay: 杜瓦罐的种类与取液器

shots.section_title: 杜瓦罐的种类与取液器
shots.scene: 双层壁和真空夹层的剖面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of a double walled container with a vacuum gap between the walls, heat arrows blocked. No text.
shots.narration: 双层壁中间抽真空，用来保冷。

shots.section_title: 杜瓦罐的种类与取液器
shots.scene: 大小不同的罐，大罐放在带轮底座上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small, medium and large dewars, the large one sitting on a wheeled base. No text.
shots.narration: 按用量选容量，大罐配带轮底座。

shots.section_title: 杜瓦罐的种类与取液器
shots.scene: 取液器装在罐口，把液体引出来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a withdrawal device fitted to the neck of a dewar with a hose leading liquid into a small container. No text.
shots.narration: 取液器装在罐口，把液氮引出来。

shots.section_title: 杜瓦罐的种类与取液器
shots.scene: 出液嘴带相分离器，液流平稳
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a discharge nozzle with a phase separator giving a smooth calm stream instead of spray. No text.
shots.narration: 出液嘴带相分离器，流得平稳少飞溅。

shots.section_title: 杜瓦罐的种类与取液器
shots.scene: 常压容器与带压容器对比，带压罐有阀门和表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unpressurized container with a loose cap next to a pressurized tank with a relief valve and a gauge. No text.
shots.narration: 有的常压用，有的带压，要分清。

shots.section_title: 正规采购，带压容器按特种设备管
shots.scene: 工厂里检验合格的罐体，合格证
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finished dewar in a factory with an inspection tick and a blank certificate document. No text.
shots.narration: 罐要由专业工厂制造、检验。
overlay: 正规采购，带压容器按特种设备管

shots.section_title: 正规采购，带压容器按特种设备管
shots.scene: 资料齐全的采购单，来路不明的罐和阀打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a purchase folder with complete documents and a tick, an unmarked secondhand tank and valve crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 走正规渠道采购，资料证明要齐全。

shots.section_title: 正规采购，带压容器按特种设备管
shots.scene: 带压低温罐挂着特种设备标识和检验牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressurized cryogenic tank with a blank registration plate and an inspection tag. No text.
shots.narration: 带压储罐和低温气瓶，按特种设备管。

shots.section_title: 正规采购，带压容器按特种设备管
shots.scene: 王老师给学生做低温设备使用培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains the female graduate student and the young male student beside a dewar.
shots.narration: 经过培训，才能使用低温容器。

shots.section_title: 透气盖和安全阀：让气体排出去
shots.scene: 罐口透气盖松放，气体从缝隙排出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loose vented cap on the neck of a dewar with gas arrows escaping around it. No text.
shots.narration: 低温液体一直汽化，必须让气排出去。
overlay: 透气盖和安全阀：让气体排出去

shots.section_title: 透气盖和安全阀：让气体排出去
shots.scene: 【实拍】静置空罐的罐口和配套透气盖（特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the neck of an empty dewar at rest with its matching vented cap sitting loosely on top.
shots.narration: 罐口只用配套透气盖，不塞死不缠死。

shots.section_title: 透气盖和安全阀：让气体排出去
shots.scene: 【实拍】静置空罐顶部的安全阀和压力表（特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the relief valve and the pressure gauge on top of an empty pressurized dewar at rest.
shots.narration: 带压罐靠安全阀，放掉多余压力。

shots.section_title: 透气盖和安全阀：让气体排出去
shots.scene: 拆改安全阀、压力表打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrench removing a relief valve and a hand tampering with a gauge, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 安全阀、压力表，不得自行拆改。

shots.section_title: 透气盖和安全阀：让气体排出去
shots.scene: 罐口进水汽结冰，堵住泄压通道
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: moist air entering the neck of a dewar and forming an ice plug over the vent path. No text.
shots.narration: 水汽进罐结冰，会堵住泄压通道。

shots.section_title: 透气盖和安全阀：让气体排出去
shots.scene: 盖好盖子，罐口结冰及时报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dewar with its cap in place in a dry room, an ice plug icon with a phone icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 盖好透气盖，发现结冰堵塞要报告。

shots.section_title: 透气盖和安全阀：让气体排出去
shots.scene: 有压力时拆取液器打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand unscrewing a withdrawal device while the gauge shows pressure, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 罐内有压力时，不拆接头和取液器。

shots.section_title: 充装与取液：少拆装、慢慢来
shots.scene: 从大罐经软管接口给小罐充装
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a transfer hose connected from a supply tank fitting to a receiving dewar fitting. No text.
shots.narration: 充装时经接口接软管，不用拆部件。
overlay: 充装与取液：少拆装、慢慢来

shots.section_title: 充装与取液：少拆装、慢慢来
shots.scene: 少拆装冷部件，接头少磨损少泄漏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cold fitting connected once with a tick, repeated unscrewing with worn threads crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 少拆冷部件，更快更安全，少泄漏。

shots.section_title: 充装与取液：少拆装、慢慢来
shots.scene: 穿戴面屏和低温手套慢慢开阀充装
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trained person in a face shield and cryogenic gloves slowly opening a fill valve, standing to the side. No text.
shots.narration: 穿戴好防护，慢慢开阀，人站侧面。

shots.section_title: 充装与取液：少拆装、慢慢来
shots.scene: 液位到了停止，不灌满
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dewar with a liquid level line below the top and a stop hand icon. No text.
shots.narration: 看好液位，不要灌得太满。

shots.section_title: 充装与取液：少拆装、慢慢来
shots.scene: 充装在通风好的地方，旁边有氧报警
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a filling area with an open door, an exhaust fan and an oxygen monitor on the wall. No text.
shots.narration: 在通风处充装，留意氧含量报警。

shots.section_title: 搬运：推车慢行，人罐分离乘电梯
shots.scene: 罐放在推车上，固定好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dewar strapped upright on a low wheeled trolley. No text.
shots.narration: 搬运用推车，罐子直立固定好。
overlay: 搬运：推车慢行，人罐分离乘电梯

shots.section_title: 搬运：推车慢行，人罐分离乘电梯
shots.scene: 【实拍】推着装空罐的推车慢行（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a person in closed shoes slowly pushing an empty dewar on a trolley along a clear corridor.
shots.narration: 推车要慢要稳，防止倾倒碰撞。

shots.section_title: 搬运：推车慢行，人罐分离乘电梯
shots.scene: 两人配合搬大罐过门槛
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two people working together to guide a large dewar on a trolley over a threshold. No text.
shots.narration: 大罐两人配合，不扛不拖不滚。

shots.section_title: 搬运：推车慢行，人罐分离乘电梯
shots.scene: 人和液氮罐同乘电梯打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: people riding in a lift together with a liquid nitrogen dewar, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 液氮罐绝不与人同乘电梯。

shots.section_title: 搬运：推车慢行，人罐分离乘电梯
shots.scene: 电梯停在半路，轿厢里氧气下降
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lift stuck between floors, an oxygen level arrow dropping inside the car. No text.
shots.narration: 电梯一停，同乘的人可能缺氧。

shots.section_title: 搬运：推车慢行，人罐分离乘电梯
shots.scene: 【实拍】空罐单独放进电梯，挂提示牌（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: an empty dewar on a trolley placed alone in a lift car with a blank warning card hung on it, the door closing.
shots.narration: 罐子单独上，挂提示牌，别人别进。

shots.section_title: 搬运：推车慢行，人罐分离乘电梯
shots.scene: 一人在楼下送，一人在楼上接
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one person sending the lift on the ground floor and another person waiting at the upper floor to receive the dewar. No text.
shots.narration: 楼下有人送，楼上有人接。

shots.section_title: 低温阀门：慢开、站侧面、不硬扳
shots.scene: 低温截止阀剖面：手轮、加长阀杆、阀芯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of a cryogenic globe valve showing a handwheel, an extended stem and a valve disc pressing on a seat. No text.
shots.narration: 低温截止阀，开关液氮等低温介质。
overlay: 低温阀门：慢开、站侧面、不硬扳

shots.section_title: 低温阀门：慢开、站侧面、不硬扳
shots.scene: 加长阀杆让手轮离冷的部分远
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long stem keeping the handwheel far from the frosted lower part of the valve. No text.
shots.narration: 加长阀杆，让手离冷的部分远一些。

shots.section_title: 低温阀门：慢开、站侧面、不硬扳
shots.scene: 弹簧压紧填料，补偿低温收缩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spring pressing on stem packing to keep it tight as the cold makes parts shrink. No text.
shots.narration: 低温下密封会收缩，靠弹簧压紧防漏。

shots.section_title: 低温阀门：慢开、站侧面、不硬扳
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴低温手套，站在侧面慢转手轮（静置阀门，手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand in a cryogenic glove slowly turning a valve handwheel while the body stays to the side of the outlet.
shots.narration: 开关要慢，人站侧面，不对出口。

shots.section_title: 低温阀门：慢开、站侧面、不硬扳
shots.scene: 锤击阀门、加力杆打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hammer hitting a valve and a cheater bar on a handwheel, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不得锤击阀门，不得用加力杆。

shots.section_title: 低温阀门：慢开、站侧面、不硬扳
shots.scene: 口径和接口匹配，由专业人员按图选型
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a valve and a pipe with matching end connections, the facility engineer checking a blank drawing. No text.
shots.narration: 口径接口要匹配，由专业人员选型。

shots.section_title: 低温阀门：慢开、站侧面、不硬扳
shots.scene: 阀门定期检查维护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer inspecting a valve with a checklist and a calendar icon. No text.
shots.narration: 阀门要定期检查维护。

shots.section_title: 液体封闭会超压，维修先泄压回温
shots.scene: 两只阀门之间关住了液体，受热升压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid trapped in a pipe between two closed valves, warming and a pressure arrow rising sharply. No text.
shots.narration: 液体关在两阀之间，受热会急剧升压。
overlay: 液体封闭会超压，维修先泄压回温

shots.section_title: 液体封闭会超压，维修先泄压回温
shots.scene: 管段上的安全泄放阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small relief valve on the pipe section between the two valves venting safely upward. No text.
shots.narration: 这段管子要有安全泄放装置。

shots.section_title: 液体封闭会超压，维修先泄压回温
shots.scene: 堵住安全阀、关断泄放阀打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a relief valve plugged with a cap and an isolation valve closed under it, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 安全阀不能堵，不能随意关断。

shots.section_title: 液体封闭会超压，维修先泄压回温
shots.scene: 维修前关阀、泄压、回温，再确认无压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three steps, closing valves, venting to zero on a gauge, waiting as frost melts. No text.
shots.narration: 维修前关阀、泄压、回温，确认无压。

shots.section_title: 液体封闭会超压，维修先泄压回温
shots.scene: 带压拆卸打叉，挂牌上锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrench on a pressurized fitting crossed out, a lock and a tag on the closed valve with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 不带压拆卸，挂牌上锁防误开。

shots.section_title: 储罐会自己升压，安全阀排气是正常的
shots.scene: 储罐给切割机、实验楼供氮气和氧气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an outdoor cryogenic tank supplying nitrogen and oxygen through pipes to a building and a cutting machine. No text.
shots.narration: 实验楼、加工间常用液氮液氧供气。
overlay: 储罐会自己升压，安全阀排气是正常的

shots.section_title: 储罐会自己升压，安全阀排气是正常的
shots.scene: 外界的热慢慢传进罐内，压力升高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: heat arrows slowly entering a tank, the liquid boiling gently and a gauge needle rising. No text.
shots.narration: 外面的热慢慢传进去，罐里压力升高。

shots.section_title: 储罐会自己升压，安全阀排气是正常的
shots.scene: 安全阀起跳，嘶嘶排气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a relief valve on top of a tank opening with a hissing sound wave icon. No text.
shots.narration: 压力高了，安全阀嘶嘶排气，有时很响。

shots.section_title: 储罐会自己升压，安全阀排气是正常的
shots.scene: 盾牌图标护着储罐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield icon over a tank with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 这是储罐在自我保护，属于正常。

shots.section_title: 结霜挂水、白雾一喷：快排气了别靠近

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ring of frost and water droplets forming around the top fittings of a tank. No text.
shots.narration: 罐顶结霜挂水，说明压力在升高。
overlay: 结霜挂水、白雾一喷：快排气了别靠近

shots.section_title: 结霜挂水、白雾一喷：快排气了别靠近
shots.scene: 排气时喷出一大团白雾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sudden large white cloud bursting out from the vent of a tank. No text.
shots.narration: 排气时，会突然喷出一大团白雾。

shots.section_title: 结霜挂水、白雾一喷：快排气了别靠近
shots.scene: 白雾是空气中的水汽遇冷凝结
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: water vapour in the air turning into a white fog when meeting cold gas. No text.
shots.narration: 白雾是水汽遇冷凝成的，不是烟。

shots.section_title: 结霜挂水、白雾一喷：快排气了别靠近
shots.scene: 没准备的人被吓一跳
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a startled visitor jumping back from a sudden white cloud. No text.
shots.narration: 没准备的人，会被吓一大跳。

shots.section_title: 结霜挂水、白雾一喷：快排气了别靠近
shots.scene: 老李提前请访客离开排气口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer calmly asks visitors to step away from the vent before it releases.
shots.narration: 快排气时，请人离开，先说明别怕。

shots.section_title: 结霜挂水、白雾一喷：快排气了别靠近
shots.scene: 排气口不对着人和通道
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vent pipe pointing up and away from a walkway and people. No text.
shots.narration: 排气口不能对着人和通道。

shots.section_title: 结霜挂水、白雾一喷：快排气了别靠近

shots.narration: 罐身外壁大片结霜出汗，停用报告。

shots.section_title: 汽化器：结霜正常，异常结冰要报告

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ambient air vaporizer with tall aluminium finned tubes turning cold liquid into gas. No text.
shots.narration: 汽化器靠铝翅片吸收空气的热。
overlay: 汽化器：结霜正常，异常结冰要报告

shots.section_title: 汽化器：结霜正常，异常结冰要报告
shots.scene: 翅片上结白霜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: white frost forming along the finned tubes of the vaporizer. No text.
shots.narration: 空气里的水汽遇冷，结成白霜。

shots.section_title: 汽化器：结霜正常，异常结冰要报告
shots.scene: 不同气体用各自的设备，氧气专用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: separate vaporizers for nitrogen and oxygen with different blank tags, an oxygen one with a no oil icon. No text.
shots.narration: 不同气体用专用设备，氧气不能混用。

shots.section_title: 汽化器：结霜正常，异常结冰要报告
shots.scene: 冰结太厚，下游管子变冷变脆
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vaporizer encased in thick ice, very cold gas flowing on into a downstream pipe that frosts over. No text.
shots.narration: 冰结太厚，汽化不足，管路会变脆。

shots.section_title: 汽化器：结霜正常，异常结冰要报告
shots.scene: 敲打翅片除冰打叉，报告专业人员
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hammer hitting frosted fins crossed out, a phone icon calling the facility engineer with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 不敲打翅片，异常结冰报告专业人员。

shots.section_title: 储罐站：专人管理，学生不得操作
shots.scene: 储罐站四周有围栏和门锁，挂警示标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cryogenic tank yard enclosed by a fence with a locked gate and a no entry sign and a no smoking sign. No text.
shots.narration: 储罐站要围起来，由专人管理。
overlay: 储罐站：专人管理，学生不得操作

shots.section_title: 储罐站：专人管理，学生不得操作
shots.scene: 学生进围栏、拧阀门打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student climbing into the fenced yard and turning a tank valve, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 学生不得擅自进入、操作阀门。

shots.section_title: 储罐站：专人管理，学生不得操作
shots.scene: 储罐直立固定，周围通风
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tank anchored upright on a concrete base in an open well ventilated yard. No text.
shots.narration: 储罐直立固定，放在通风好的地方。

shots.section_title: 储罐站：专人管理，学生不得操作
shots.scene: 储罐区装氧含量报警，阀门禁油
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tank yard with an oxygen monitor post and a valve with a no oil icon. No text.
shots.narration: 必要时装氧含量报警，液氧阀门禁油。

shots.section_title: 储罐站：专人管理，学生不得操作
shots.scene: 老李按规定检查储罐，资料登记
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the tank with a checklist next to a blank registration plate.
shots.narration: 储罐属压力容器，按特种设备管理。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 透气盖、安全阀两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a loose vented cap and a relief valve. No text.
shots.narration: 杜瓦：配套透气盖，安全阀不拆不堵。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 推车和人罐分离的电梯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a dewar on a trolley and a lift with a dewar alone inside. No text.
shots.narration: 搬运：推车慢行，人罐分离。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 白雾和围栏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a tank releasing white fog and a fenced tank yard with a locked gate. No text.
shots.narration: 排气白雾别靠近，储罐站不乱碰。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白的作业许可证挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank work permit form on a clipboard and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：第12章，作业许可制度。
